subtext.hi: Har composite number ko prime factors ke ek hi unique combination mein likha ja sakta hai.
subtext.en: Every composite number can be written as one unique combination of prime factors.

text.hi: Jaise har insaan ka fingerprint unique hota hai, waise hi har number ka prime factorization unique hota hai — order chahe kuch bhi ho. 12 hamesha 2×2×3 hi rahega, chahe tum likho 2×3×2 ya 3×2×2.
text.en: Just like every person's fingerprint is unique, every number's prime factorization is unique too — regardless of order. 12 is always 2×2×3, whether you write it as 2×3×2 or 3×2×2.

content.hi: Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic (FTA) kehta hai: har composite number ko prime numbers ke product ke roop mein likha ja sakta hai, aur ye factorization unique hoti hai (factors ke order ko chhod kar).
content.en: The Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic (FTA) states: every composite number can be expressed as a product of prime numbers, and this factorization is unique (except for the order of the factors).

content.hi: Iska sabse bada use hai HCF aur LCM nikaalna jab prime factorization pata ho.
content.en: Its biggest application is finding HCF and LCM once you know the prime factorization.

explanation.content:
HCF = product of smallest powers of common primes
LCM = product of greatest powers of all primes involved

problem.hi: 96 aur 404 ka HCF aur LCM prime factorization se nikaalo.
problem.en: Find the HCF and LCM of 96 and 404 using prime factorization.

steps.en: HCF = 2^2 = 4 (smallest power of the common prime)

summary.hi: FTA se hume pata chalta hai ki prime factorization unique hai — isi se HCF aur LCM turant nikal sakte hain.
summary.en: FTA tells us prime factorization is unique — this lets us find HCF and LCM directly.
